title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Fowler Saddened by Tour Cut
items.text: Rickie Fowler shot a 63 to start the Rocket Classic but is unhappy because the PGA Tour will drop the event after 2026, ending his strong Detroit connection.

items.headline: Dalke’s Rocky Return
items.text: Brad Dalke described his opening 81 at the Rocket Classic as "nightmare fuel," struggling with seven bogeys, a double, and a quadruple, aiming to recover on Friday.

items.headline: Malnati Leads Rocket Classic
items.text: Peter Malnati holds the 36-hole lead at 9-under at the Rocket Classic, with Rickie Fowler and Ryan Gerard two shots behind at 7-under.
